The '''Sword Cane''' was a traditional accessory favored by aristocrats who occasionally needed to defend themselves or make a point. It combined the function of a walking stick with hidden protection. A simple twist released the handle, allowing the blade to be drawn quickly. While some featured [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], most contained unpowered blades for better concealment. Though it lacked the weight and lethality of a combat weapon, the sword cane served as an effective defensive tool and could be deadly in the hands of a skilled duelist.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sword Cane was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
